description: Pictures stored as interference patterns in a complex outer-product holographic memory, reconstructed by projection from noisy or fragmented cues. Four 16x16 pictures (circle, cross, bars, checker) stored as one interference record W = sum |p><p|; reconstruction by projection, with a cue pipeline (noise + occlusion). Verified: correct winner at every tested (sigma, occlusion) including sigma=0.5 / 50% occlusion gone; field fidelity 0.73-0.79 (crosstalk -- the pictures are correlated, bars vs checker share half their pixels); reconstruction always beats the cue. Two measurement-driven distinctions: classification vs optical reconstruction (winner 1.0, field ~0.75); weights diluted by correlation (clean-probe weight 0.65-0.75). Honest limits: toy images, amplitude encoding only (phase unused), the mathematics of holography, not optical holography. Stdlib-only Python, seeded, 8/8 tests pass.
title: Image Hologram
